[Story]
In the past, on weekends, Old Li always sends his son, Little Li, to his mother's house. Later, Little Li gradually stops going. One day, the mother calls Old Li.\n"Son, I install wifi at home and also buy a new computer, you tell my grandson for me."

[Question]
What does the mother really mean when she says this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. The mother hopes that Little Li helps her learn how to use the new computer.
B. The mother hopes that Old Li brings Little Li to her house more often.
C. The mother hopes that Little Li can help her test the newly installed wifi.
D. The mother hopes to share the new changes at home with Old Li.
